categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai International Airport Co., Ltd. primarily operates in civil airport operations, providing ground support services for domestic and international airlines and passengers. Its business segments include aviation-related services such as aircraft takeoff and landing fees, passenger and cargo services, and non-aviation services including commercial leasing, retail, catering, advertising, logistics, and property management. The company manages two major airports: Shanghai Pudong International Airport and Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced airport infrastructure and efficient operational support systems to ensure safe and smooth aircraft ground handling. It integrates digital and intelligent technologies to enhance airport operations, including smart service platforms and electronic cargo handling systems. The company also emphasizes safety management systems, environmental protection technologies, and green airport initiatives such as photovoltaic and electric vehicle charging infrastructure.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international airlines, passengers, cargo operators, retail tenants, and logistics service users. The company serves the aviation transportation industry and related sectors such as logistics, retail, and commercial services. Its markets cover passenger travel, cargo transport, and airport commercial operations, focusing on the Yangtze River Delta region and international transit hubs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Shanghai, China, managing Shanghai Pudong International Airport and Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport. Its service coverage extends to the Yangtze River Delta economic zone and connects globally with 291 passenger and cargo destinations across 48 countries. It also holds investments and operations in Hong Kong and other regions through subsidiaries and joint ventures.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai International Airport operates primarily in the midstream segment of the aviation supply chain, providing airport ground services, passenger facilitation, cargo handling, and commercial leasing. It acts as a critical hub connecting upstream airline operations with downstream passenger and cargo markets, while also engaging in logistics and retail services that extend its role in the broader supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on building a world-class international aviation hub with strategic priorities including aviation hub development, high-quality growth, value creation, organizational control, and harmonious development. It emphasizes digital transformation, green and intelligent airport construction, safety management modernization, and enhancing passenger experience. R&D initiatives target smart airport services, logistics innovation, and environmental sustainability technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through aviation-related fees such as aircraft takeoff and landing charges, passenger and cargo service fees, and non-aviation commercial income including retail leasing, advertising, catering, and logistics services. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment returns, and financial asset management. Its revenue streams are diversified across aviation and non-aviation sectors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai International Airport is positioned as a leading airport operator in China and Asia, competing with other major hubs such as Guangzhou Baiyun Airport, Beijing Capital and Daxing Airports, and Hong Kong International Airport. It holds a top ranking in passenger throughput and cargo volume in the Asia-Pacific region and is recognized for high service quality and operational efficiency, aiming to be a global benchmark in airport management.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 12.37 billion in 2024, representing an 11.97% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 1.93 billion, more than doubling compared to the previous year. Total assets stood at RMB 70.05 billion with steady growth, supported by strong cash flows and ongoing investments in infrastructure and technology. The company maintains a stable and growing financial profile with increasing profitability and asset base.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai International Airport emphasizes its strategic geographic location as a gateway connecting Asia, Europe, and North America, offering efficient and high-quality aviation and commercial services. It differentiates itself through advanced infrastructure, integrated smart and green airport solutions, comprehensive safety management, and superior passenger experience. The company leverages its dual-airport system to provide extensive route networks, seamless transit services, and diversified commercial offerings, positioning itself as a world-class, full-service international aviation hub.
